missed.part: TPD2S701-Q1 (LCSC C2865204, TPD2S701QDSKRQ1; also TPD2S703-Q1, C5216312)
missed.maker: Texas Instruments (datasheet; jlcparts maker field blank, not read at JLCPCB); allowlisted as Texas Instruments (S1)
missed.why: A family of adjustable-threshold data-line OVP (overvoltage protection) switches that P2 did not consider. It fails 'D+/D- steady voltage (V12)', so it is listed for the re-rank to close. Datasheet SLLSEY0A (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd2s701-q1.pdf, read 2026-09-29T00:43:15Z) gives these figures. Mode 1 threshold: VOVP_RISING is 1.19 to 1.31 x VREF, with VREF accuracy +/-8 %. At VREF 3.3 V, VOVP is 3.61 min, 4.14 typ, 4.67 max. Mode 0 needs VREF 3 to 3.6 V. The internal D+ and D- absolute maximum is VREF + 0.3 V. To bring the maximum threshold down to 3.63 V, VREF must fall to about 2.6 V. The minimum threshold then falls to about 2.8 V and the internal-pin absolute maximum to about 2.9 V, both below the 3.3 V full-speed level the RP2354B drives. So no VREF setting keeps the steady voltage at or below 3.63 V and passes USB. It also covers D+ and D- only (IEC 61000-4-2 +/-8 kV contact, +/-15 kV air). TPD2S703-Q1 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd2s703-q1.pdf, read 00:43:18Z) has the same OVP table. Its jlcparts stock is 5.

missed.maker: Texas Instruments (datasheet; jlcparts maker 'Texas Instruments'); allowlisted (S1)
missed.why: USB 2.0 VBUS and data-line protectors that P2 did not consider. Both fail 'D+/D- steady voltage (V12)'. The VD+/VD- OVP threshold follows the VIN pin, tied to the 3.3 V I/O rail: VIN + 0.6 V min, VIN + 0.8 V typ, VIN + 1 V max. At VIN 3.3 V that is 3.9 to 4.3 V, so a steady 3.63 to 3.9 V passes to the system side. Sources: SLVSCG4C (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd3s714-q1.pdf, read 2026-09-29T00:43:16Z) and SLVSDH9D (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd3s716-q1.pdf, read 00:43:18Z). The VBUS OVP is 5.4 to 5.8 V (TPD3S714-Q1). No CC pins, so 'lines covered' also needs other parts. The jlcparts copy shows 44 and 0 in stock; not read at JLCPCB. Listed for the re-rank to close.

missed.maker: Diodes Incorporated (Pericom; jlcparts maker 'Diodes Incorporated'); allowlisted (S1)
missed.why: A USB 2.0 switch 'With Vbus Short Protection' that P2 did not consider. It fails, or at best does not show, 'D+/D- steady voltage (V12)'. Datasheet DS42424 Rev 4-2 (https://www.diodes.com/assets/Datasheets/PI3USB42.pdf, read 2026-09-29T00:47:00Z; pages 1, 3 and 4 viewed as images) says: 'If the Vin (D+/-) is 0.6V greater than VDD, USB42 will turn off the switch'. It gives no min or max for that threshold. The recommended switch input maximum is VDD + 0.5 V, and VDD runs 1.8 to 4.5 V. On the 3.3 V rail that is about 3.9 V, above 3.63 V. It covers D+ and D- only; ESD is >8 kV HBM only. Listed for the re-rank to close.

missed.maker: Texas Instruments (datasheet; jlcparts maker 'Texas Instruments'); allowlisted (S1)
missed.why: A FET (field-effect transistor) bus switch whose output tracks VCC. The switch as a series limiter, behind a shunt ESD array such as VBUS54CV, is an approach P2 did not consider. It is not qualified: 'D+/D- steady voltage (V12)' is not shown. SCDS150A (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74cb3t1g125.pdf, read 2026-09-29T00:43:17Z), Figure 1 note A: for an input from VCC - 1 V to 5.5 V, 'the output high voltage (VOH) level will be equal to approximately the VCC voltage level'. That is a typical figure. Figure 4 gives only typical VOH curves, and no maximum output voltage is specified. Data I/O range 0 to 5.5 V; Ioff 10 uA max at VCC 0; Cio(ON) 4 pF; ron 5 Ohm typ. It has no IEC 61000-4-2 rating (2 kV HBM), so it needs the clamp array for V9. With VCC on the 3.3 V rail (3.399 V max), the typical output stays under 3.63 V. No datasheet figure guarantees it. SN74CB3T3306 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74cb3t3306.pdf, read 00:43:17Z) is the 2-bit version from the same datasheet family. No USB protection family found in this search shows a steady limit of 3.63 V or less while passing the 3.3 V full-speed signal. The USB protection function stays without a qualifying part.
